step1_analysis.circuit_type: Biomorphic Digital Image Sensor Pixel Amplifier / Comparator
step1_analysis.description: A high-gain, low-voltage inverting amplifier/comparator used in an address-event integrate-and-fire pixel. It features a dynamic feedback mechanism (XM6) to provide high gain and fast switching while operating at a reduced supply voltage (0.9V) within a 1.8V well.

DC_Gain.description: Maximum low-frequency voltage gain (derivative of Vout w.r.t Vin)

sky130_expected.calculation: Single stage with dynamic feedback can achieve very high equivalent gain. Estimated at 40-80 dB depending on load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the feedback dynamics and load. 180 dB is likely an open-loop or cascaded equivalent from the paper.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * R_out * C_load). With 100k load and 10fF, f_3dB ~ 160 MHz. However, internal nodes may limit it.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 is much faster than 0.6um, so bandwidth will be significantly higher than 200 kHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Paper value is likely for the entire 80x60 array. Per pixel power = 3.4mW / 4800 = 0.7 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for single pixel operation in a modern node.

Propagation_Delay.description: Time delay between input and output crossing 50% threshold

sky130_expected.calculation: Sky130 has smaller parasitic capacitances, so delay should be comparable or smaller.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be around 1-3 ns based on paper and technology scaling.
Matches the lower end of the paper's reported values (0.06 pJ = 60 fJ).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, AC bandwidth, propagation delay, power, and energy of the pixel amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Biomorphic Digital Image Sensor Pixel Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

XM1 N2 N0 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N3 LABEL_NET_2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

Rload N2 GND 100k
Cload N2 GND 10f

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.45 ac 1 pulse(0 0.9 1n 100p 100p 2u 4u)

.control
  * DC Analysis
  dc VLABEL_NET_1 0 0.9 0.001
  meas dc trip_point when v(N2)=0.45 fall=1
  let gain_dc = deriv(v(N2))
  meas dc max_dc_gain max gain_dc
  
  * AC Analysis
  alter VLABEL_NET_1 dc = $&trip_point
  op
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let vout_db = vdb(N2)
  meas ac ac_gain_db max vout_db
  let gain_3db = ac_gain_db - 3
  meas ac bandwidth when vout_db=gain_3db fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis
  alter VLABEL_NET_1 dc = 0
  tran 10p 5u
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(LABEL_NET_1) val=0.45 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=0.45 fall=1
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(LABEL_NET_1) val=0.45 fall=1 targ v(N2) val=0.45 rise=1
  let delay_avg = (delay_fall + delay_rise) / 2
  print delay_avg
  
  let pwr = - (i(VVDD)*1.8 + i(VLABEL_NET_0)*0.9 + i(VLABEL_NET_2)*0.9)
  meas tran avg_power avg pwr
  
  let energy_op = avg_power * delay_avg
  print energy_op
  
  quit
.endc
